summary: Integrate diverged local and remote main without reverting existing peer protections, then close wheel Web/Feishu/Learning desired/live/stable with exact installed identity and independent worker lifecycle.

components.disposition: reuse existing wheel identity and lifecycle state machine; preserve source deployment
components.verification_level: targeted regression passed; independent GLM-5.3 and original full R9 required before production
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Existing service_control action logs, barriers, explicit operator release/adopt and retained release rollback remain available. No model semantic policy added.
components.rollback_route: Retain the previous wheel release, config/unit backups and original data; restore via controlled deployment and verify actual processes.

components.disposition: merge existing upstream implementations; preserve remote D15 bind guard, enabled-kind admission, effect-id claim and requester-keyed authentication together with local slot quota and write-root gate; do not activate new peer kinds
components.verification_level: focused merge regression and independent complete-candidate review plus unchanged R9 required
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Existing peer receipts/reason codes, operator configured enabled kinds, lease revoke and disabled-by-default supervision stay authoritative. Merge does not remove those controls.

g1.necessity: Only the process can attest its actual distribution, interpreter and installed bytes. A model cannot make a child survive the Linux service cgroup being stopped; the fixed systemd transient unit supplies that physical separation.

g2.authority_owner: Existing ManagedServiceDeploymentStore, installer release checksum and systemd user manager.
g2.non_duplication: Use existing CAS, barriers, worker, verification and receipt states; add a wheel physical adapter instead of a second controller.

model_evidence: Desired includes exact version, digest and release directory.
Live startup records verified distribution and installed bytes; mismatches are visible.
Workers retain real physical exit and per-service verification evidence.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Caller retains restart choice and existing operator barrier release/adopt and retained release rollback. Unit preparation can use --no-start.

g4.rollback: Retain previous release/data/config/unit backups; restore actual services before considering recovery complete.
verification: Four new regressions fail against the original candidate.
56 backend regressions and 6 UI cases passed, including all three service SHA mismatch inputs.
Independent GLM-5.3 PASS and unchanged full R9 exit 0 required before production.
Production must show three actual wheel processes, matching manifest identity and real succeeded stable receipt.
Before closing the migration window, explicitly enable recovery and all three user units without --now, verify each is enabled, and require Linger=yes for unattended boot.

g1.necessity: Merge conflict resolution must retain the existing physical safety properties from both committed branches: no plaintext LAN mount, server-side enabled-kind boundary, atomic effect claim, requester-keyed auth, lock-local quota and sealed write root.

g2.authority_owner: Existing PeerService, PeerStore, registry and operator configuration.
g2.non_duplication: No replacement policy or second peer executor; combine already implemented guards from both branches.

model_evidence: Both source branch histories are preserved in the merge ancestry.
Original remote guard regression tests and local quota/write-root tests remain present.
Any admission denial retains the existing structured reason and receipt.
g3.recovery_or_reason: Operator can retain peer disabled or revoke grants; fs.write remains unadvertised and supervised admission remains disabled.

g4.rollback: Retain both parent commits and the original production release/data; merge does not migrate peer data.
verification: Run the union of tests/peer and wheel identity regressions, including the original four disputed guard cases.
Independent reviewer checks all staged paths and seven conflict files before the original complete R9.
Production acceptance remains confined to Web/Feishu/Learning wheel processes and their unchanged model profiles.
